text: Sorry if this is a silly one. My stepdaughter is 5 and has chickenpox, spots everywhere and she keeps scratching them. Her temp just now was 39.6 which seemed high to me. She was sick once earlier but has kept her drinks down since then, no problem. She's going to the toilet for a wee as normal so I don't think she's drying out. Otherwise she seems her usual self apart from the itching. Her mum's away so I wasn't sure if I'm overreacting or not
